title: Near-Optimal Regret for KL-Regularized Multi-Armed Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2603.02155v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent studies have shown that reinforcement learning with KL-regularized objectives can enjoy faster rates of convergence or logarithmic regret, in contrast to the classical $\sqrt{T}$-type regret in the unregularized setting. However, the statistical efficiency of online learning with respect to KL-regularized objectives remains far from completely characterized, even when specialized to multi-armed bandits (MABs). We address this problem for MABs via a sharp analysis of KL-UCB using a novel peeling argument, which yields a $\tilde{O}(\eta K\log^2T)$ upper bound: the first high-probability regret bound with linear dependence on $K$. Here, $T$ is the time horizon, $K$ is the number of arms, $\eta^{-1}$ is the regularization intensity, and $\tilde{O}$ hides all logarithmic factors except those involving $\log T$. translated_title: KL正则化多臂老虎机的近最优后悔界
translated_abstract: 近年来的研究表明，带有KL正则化目标的强化学习能够获得更快的收敛速度或对数级后悔，这与未正则化设定下经典的 $\sqrt{T}$ 型后悔形成鲜明对比。然而，即使是针对多臂老虎机（MAB）这一特殊情形，关于KL正则化目标的在线学习的统计效率仍然远未被完全刻画。我们通过对KL-UCB算法进行精细分析，并采用一种新颖的分层论证方法，解决了多臂老虎机中的这一问题，得到了 $\tilde{O}(\eta K\log^2T)$ 的上界：这是首个对臂数 $K$ 呈线性依赖的高概率后悔界。其中，$T$ 表示时间范围，$K$ 表示臂数，$\eta^{-1}$ 表示正则化强度，$\tilde{O}$ 隐藏了除涉及 $\log T$ 之外的所有对数因子。我们分析的近紧性由首个非常数下界 $\Omega(\eta K \log T)$ 所证实……
tldr: 该论文通过新颖的分层论证对KL-UCB算法进行精细分析，首次给出了对臂数 $K$ 呈线性依赖的高概率后悔上界 $\tilde{O}(\eta K\log^2T)$，并以首个非常数下界 $\Omega(\eta K\log T)$ 证明了其近紧性。
